'''Glass Shards''' are an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] at [[the Beach]] or from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] or [[Artifact Trove]]s.

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Gifting==
{{GiftsByItem
|like=Dwarf,Penny

}}

==Tailoring==
Glass Shards are used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Officer Uniform]].  [[File:Shirt240.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Glass Shards are not used in any [[quests]].
